description: Adds a channel of stepped control voltage, placed immediately to the right of a Basic Sequencer, Binary Sequencer, Dual 8 Step Sequencer, 8 Step Trigger Sequencer or Gated Comparator

params.text: Sets the voltage carried by OUT while the sequencer is on that step, 0V to 8V before the SCALE switch is applied
Sets the range of the CV outputs to 2V, 4V or 8V, a step knob at its maximum giving that voltage

outputs.text: The knob voltage for whichever step the sequencer is on, scaled by the SCALE switch
The knob voltage for whichever step the sequencer is on, scaled by the SCALE switch and then negated

notes: the CHANNEL light shows which channel of the sequencer this module follows, in the colour of that channel's knobs; the direction, length and current step all come from that channel
more expanders can be chained by placing each one immediately to the right of the last, in any combination and any order; each expander in the chain adds one sample of delay
